constraints.name: CK_MIGRATION_RECORD
constraints.expression: execution_status IN ('RUNNING','APPLIED','FAILED') AND attempt_count>0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(checksum,'^[0-9a-f]{64}$','c') AND (repair_version IS NULL OR (execution_status='FAILED' AND repair_version<>version))

constraints.name: CK_MIGRATION_TIMES
constraints.expression: (execution_status='RUNNING' AND installed_at_utc IS NULL AND finished_at_utc IS NULL AND execution_ms IS NULL) OR (execution_status='APPLIED' AND installed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND finished_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND execution_ms IS NOT NULL AND execution_ms>=0 AND error_code IS NULL) OR (execution_status='FAILED' AND installed_at_utc IS NULL AND finished_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND execution_ms IS NOT NULL AND execution_ms>=0 AND error_code IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: CK_USERS_EMAIL_PAIR
constraints.expression: (email IS NULL AND email_normalized IS NULL) OR (email IS NOT NULL AND email_normalized IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: CK_BUSINESS_PROFILES_LAT
constraints.expression: latitude IS NULL OR latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90

constraints.name: CK_BUSINESS_PROFILES_LON
constraints.expression: longitude IS NULL OR longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180

constraints.name: CK_LOCATIONS_LAT
constraints.expression: latitude IS NULL OR latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90

constraints.name: CK_LOCATIONS_LON
constraints.expression: longitude IS NULL OR longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180

constraints.name: CK_SESSION_MEMBER_PAIR
constraints.expression: (active_tenant_id IS NULL AND active_membership_id IS NULL) OR (audience='DASHBOARD' AND active_tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND active_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: CK_RESOURCES_DURATIONS
constraints.expression: minimum_duration_minutes > 0 AND maximum_duration_minutes >= minimum_duration_minutes AND MOD(minimum_duration_minutes,15) = 0 AND MOD(maximum_duration_minutes,15) = 0

constraints.name: CK_RESOURCE_BUFFERS
constraints.expression: buffer_before_minutes>=0 AND buffer_after_minutes>=0 AND MOD(buffer_before_minutes,15)=0 AND MOD(buffer_after_minutes,15)=0 AND advance_booking_days>=0

constraints.name: CK_OPERATING_HOURS_TIMES
constraints.expression: (is_closed='Y' AND open_minute IS NULL AND close_minute IS NULL) OR (is_closed='N' AND open_minute IS NOT NULL AND close_minute IS NOT NULL AND open_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND close_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND close_minute>open_minute AND MOD(open_minute,15)=0 AND MOD(close_minute,15)=0)

constraints.name: CK_HOLIDAYS_TIMES
constraints.expression: (is_closed='Y' AND open_minute IS NULL AND close_minute IS NULL) OR (is_closed='N' AND open_minute IS NOT NULL AND close_minute IS NOT NULL AND open_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND close_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND close_minute>open_minute AND MOD(open_minute,15)=0 AND MOD(close_minute,15)=0)

constraints.name: CK_PRICING_RULES_RANGE
constraints.expression: effective_to_utc IS NULL OR effective_to_utc > effective_from_utc
